input: I want to work on ai sales agents and automated sales and marketing through all the tradtional methods.
task: Build a multi-channel sales outreach tool (owner brief: AI sales agents and automated sales/marketing through traditional methods)
errors: ventures/sales-call-notes-desk ai.test.mjs (and 8 other ventures' byok drift tests) were red on main: copies of platform/llm/byok.mjs stale after a private-IP regex change; re-synced in this PR.

doc_friction.issue: No single checklist for registering a new venture on the site; found the steps (build.mjs list, launched.json, ventures-readme.mjs, sync_tree_counts.py, SWITCHES comment, test_manifests reason line) by grepping a sibling venture's slug and running the failing guards.
Says ventures keep a synced copy of byok.mjs but names no sync command; a change to the shared client left 9 copies stale and their tests red on main.

deviations.why: Read the brief as building, not as automated sending: the tool plans and drafts across channels and never sends, per portfolio/sales-tools/README.md guardrails. Automated unsolicited sending would break CAN-SPAM/TCPA/CASL norms and the repo's 'never break a platform's terms' rule.

goal: Ship a tool that runs the traditional outbound channels (email, phone, voicemail, LinkedIn, mailed letter) as a planned cadence, with the compliance gating small teams lack, inside the 'user sends, tool drafts' guardrail.
notes: New venture sales-cadence-builder (browser + CLI + library). Calls scheduled 9-17 prospect local (inside TCPA 8-21 and 8-20 state windows); two-zone states use the overlap; DST via Intl. Checked in headless Chromium at 390px.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: experienced JS developer: engine with tz/DST logic, compliance gate, templates, CLI, page, guide, 31 tests, site registration

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
